On Wednesday 15:00-15:30, only David is busy.
On Thursday 10:00-10:30, only Elena is busy.

Maybe I can ask Alison to see if either Priya or Marcus have any other availability. But first, I need to communicate my findings to Alison.

It seems I will have to report that none of the slots work. I should be polite and clear in my communication to Alison. I will list the slots and who is busy.
